knobs.note: BH-1793: the projects the lane walks, space or comma separated. Empty (the default) means the lane walks nothing and only writes its summary line. Read by bin/split-watchdog.sh as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_PROJECTS:-}. Settable from the console (the operator 2026-09-29): the value is only a FILTER over the fleet's own $PROJECTS (each name must also pass fleet-conf.sh), never a host, path or command, so a row can switch the watchdog on or off per existing project and nothing else; tests/lanes-registry-test.sh 17a lists it as a reviewed exception.
BH-1793: how long a family must sit in a state before the decider acts on it. Passed to sw_next_step. Read by bin/split-watchdog.sh as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_N_MIN:-10}.
BH-1793: how long after a failed queue row finished before the decider re-enqueues it. Passed to sw_next_step. Read by bin/split-watchdog.sh as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_RETRY_M_MIN:-30}.

BH-1793: decisions (acted + skipped) per tick across all projects; a due family past it counts deferred. Read at lane level by bin/split-watchdog.sh as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_TICK_CAP:-5}. 0 means no decision is acted on and every due family counts deferred.

BH-1793: acted steps per family per UTC day. Read by sw_act (bin/lib/split-watchdog-act.sh, BH-1809) as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_FAMILY_DAY_CAP:-4}; the lane only exports it through lane_env_apply. 0 means no action on any family.

BH-1793: repeats of the same step for the same child before sw_act reports stalled. Read by sw_act (bin/lib/split-watchdog-act.sh, BH-1809) as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_STALL_K:-3}; the lane only exports it through lane_env_apply.
BH-1793: open families examined per project per tick, in ascending parent id; the rest count deferred. Read by bin/split-watchdog.sh as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_MAX_FAMILIES:-25}.

BH-1793: the ERE of failed-queue reasons the decider may re-enqueue (jobs-watchdog's BUILD_DEFERRED/REFUSED class stays excluded). Passed to sw_next_step. Read by bin/split-watchdog.sh as ${SPLIT_WATCHDOG_RETRY_REASONS:-plan session produced no output|PLAN_STALE}.

Test seam: a file bin/split-watchdog.sh sources after the contract libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 (tests/split-watchdog-lane.bh-1793-test.sh). NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/split-watchdog.sh sources SPLIT_WATCHDOG_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
